title: Energy prices and Middle East supply disruption: questions taken in a Ministerial Statement
asked: MPs asked about petrol, diesel and electricity prices, energy security and stockpiles, and support for households and businesses affected by the Middle East conflict and supply disruptions.
asked_by: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (and other Members)
response: Mr Gan Kim Yong told the House he would be delivering a Ministerial Statement together with his colleagues later, and asked the Speaker for permission to take Question Nos 1 to 62 in that statement. The Speaker granted permission.
